description: Reviewed per-master drawing overrides. A partial UFO named exactly like its source master replaces only the glyphs it contains during every release compilation.

entries.reason: Restore a common original Regular topology after rejecting an incompatible Regular/Bold fit. The early bootstrap kept a refitted Regular even when correspondence was rejected, so equal point counts concealed different on/off-curve flags.
entries.drawing_method: Canonical bounded emboldening fallback, followed by the same condensed and grade construction used by the generator. These overrides make already prepared sources match the corrected generator without rerunning all matching.
entries.validation: Every glyph in all 24 masters of both styles passed the full contour, on-curve and component compatibility gate after applying the repaired GLIFs. Each repaired GLIF also records the migration reason in its glyph lib.
entries.grid_migration: 0.500: all 48 drawings regenerated from the same integer anchors with the shared calibrated condensed/grade grid; the three original topology repairs and their provenance remain.
